review.imagery: Root reviewed all twenty-seven original PDF pages, all five selected whole sheets, the three complete enlarged area schedules, fifteen extracted native resources and both own website contacts. Fourteen native project concepts and three corroborated own-page concepts are retained. Generic lifestyle, gym stock, food, pets, corporate imagery and duplicate crops are excluded. The current own marker names Reportage Village near Serena in Dubai. Construction photography was unavailable. Source component differences remain explicit.
review.floorPlans: All selected whole original sheets, complete numerical schedules, source notices and every drawn level visually reviewed by root. Measurement and source-edition conflicts remain explicit.
review.location: Whole original map and factsheets reviewed. Travel modes retain source scope. Unreliable phase markers are excluded. Missing coordinates use project-name directions.
review.provenance: Fresh ordinary GET receipts preserve source URLs, retrieval dates, bytes and SHA256. Every adopted whole drawing, map and native image has been root reviewed. Independent source values, native resources and delivered pixels must pass before verified status. Source reproduction terms require review before external distribution.

unavailable: Verified project construction photographs, individual-home entrances and the selected contractual drawing edition remain unavailable. Published component conflicts require confirmation.
